insight: The self-hostable, OpenTelemetry-native answer to LangSmith — pick it when observability data has to stay on your own infra.
name: Langfuse
description: Tracing, evals, prompt management, and dataset tooling for LLM apps — self-host on your own infra or use Langfuse Cloud. The open-source default when you want full ownership of your observability stack.
